assessment.rationale: No electric regional airliner is certified or in scheduled passenger service, so the Main KPI of 10,000 electric regional aircraft is unmet. Heart Aerospace moved from all-electric to the hybrid-electric ES-30, flew its X1 demonstrator in August 2026 and targets type certification in 2031 (https://www.flyingmag.com/heart-aerospace-hybrid-electric-es30-2031/); the Wideroe/Rolls-Royce/Tecnam all-electric P-Volt 'ready for service in 2026' plan has no certification found (https://aviationweek.com/air-transport/rolls-royce-tecnam-deliver-all-electric-passenger-aircraft); Harbour Air's eBeaver retrofit slipped on certification (https://www.ch-aviation.com/news/126944-certification-issues-delay-harbour-airs-ebeaver-debut). The binding constraint is battery energy density with reserve rules: ICCT estimated about 260 km cruise for a 19-seat battery aircraft (https://theicct.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/global-aviation-performance-analysis-regional-electric-aircraft-jul22-1.pdf-1.pdf) and a Cardiff 2025 study limits full-electric designs to 30 seats at 200 nmi with 480 Wh/kg (https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/184236/). Honest limit: electric motors, retrofit designs and small certified trainers (Pipistrel Velis) are prior art; tasks must target the unsolved energy-density, reserve, certification or charging problems with their own prior-art basis.

additionalSearches.query: electric regional aircraft certification 2026 Heart Aerospace ES-30 Eviation Alice status
additionalSearches.finding: Heart ES-30 is now a 30-seat hybrid-electric design targeting type certification in 2031; X1 demonstrator first flew August 2026; no current Eviation Alice status found.

additionalSearches.query: first certified all-electric passenger aircraft in commercial service 2026
additionalSearches.finding: 2021 plans promised all-electric commuter service by 2026 (Tecnam P-Volt, Heart ES-19); no certification or entry into service found.

additionalSearches.query: Harbour Air electric Beaver ePlane certification commercial flights 2026
additionalSearches.finding: Harbour Air eBeaver passenger debut delayed by certification and supply problems; ePlane 2.0 prototype planned; no confirmed 2026 commercial flights.

additionalSearches.query: battery energy density limit regional electric aircraft 19 seat range study 2025
additionalSearches.finding: Cardiff 2025: energy density and reserve rules limit full-electric aircraft to 30 passengers at 200 nmi with 480 Wh/kg; ICCT 2022 found about 260 km for 19 seats.
